A03-D03 | textsplainer (1).docx

Document text extraction. Public text edition; layout and embedded images are not reproduced.

textsplainerdialogue is a presentation of an artistic project, which will be developed at mindfuture foundation from March to August twenty-twenty-two. you can kind of watch, before you have to go to work. since there is no ‘consciousness’ behind the text, the bourgeois public's politeness requirement that you have to read the whole thing also falls away. it doesn't make much sense to have a hermeneutics for artificial intelligences. the dialogue is made with a technically updated version of the French literary technique “détournement”. that means an artist takes a base text and changes its purpose by placing it in a new context and fixing a bit here and there. so the text is a bit like this newsletter, which imagines a couple of newly hired art directors interviewing each other: https://arthubcopenhagen.net/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/Newsletter-8.pdf.men now this is what one could call by an ad hoc invented technical term a “neural détournement”, since the base text has been amplified through a pretrained language model (gpt-3). such a model can keep a particular style going for quite a long time. moreover, the text has been posted on a blog and filmed with an iphone 11. so you can also just watch.
